title: Roadside garage and blueprint workbench
summary: The opening shutter now overlooks a rainy road and upgrades have a new workshop interface.
notes: Replace the service court with wet road scenery, lane markings, street lamps and a parked car.
Keep players inside with an invisible full-height collision boundary, even while the shutter is open.
Add ImageGen blueprint artwork, selectable gear cards, live weapon previews, damage comparisons and carried salvage counts.
Keep upgrade and Back controls fixed and touch-friendly on portrait and landscape phones.
